description:
No spec subject (repo merge hygiene; no ancora behavior)

Scope expansion carved from the MERGE_CONFLICT parks on ancora-yzu.6 and ancora-yzu.7.

Problem: both approved stage branches (ancora-yzu.6/output-verdict, ancora-yzu.7/git-change-set) append attribution entries to NOTICE, and the epic branch appended its own (Parser/Schema/Index/DecisionParser port entries). Every rebase conflicts on NOTICE; rebase workers correctly refuse to hand-merge a real file. NOTICE is an append-only attribution list, so the correct resolution is always the union of both sides.

Deliverable: a .gitattributes file at the repo root containing the line 'NOTICE merge=union' (git built-in union merge strategy), committed on this ticket's stage branch. With this on the epic branch, both pending rebases and every future stage rebase auto-resolve NOTICE by keeping both sides' entries.

Verification:
- Behaviors to demonstrate: 'git check-attr merge NOTICE' reports 'merge: union' in the stage worktree
- Iteration tier: git check-attr merge NOTICE
- Final tier: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test green (no code paths touched)
- Verifier tier: read the one-line diff
- Standing bounce-class checks: n/a (no callable surface)

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- .gitattributes

Out of Scope (files):
- NOTICE (this ticket does not resolve the pending conflicts itself; the rebase workers re-run after it merges)
- lib/**, test/**, .spec/**, mix.exs, mix.lock

Out of Scope (intent):
- no other attributes, no merge drivers requiring config, no changes to append-only policy files

Merge gate:
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only .gitattributes
- [ ] Epic worktree smoke green after ff-merge
